Case studies

Two problems I solved, and why they matter in clinical research.

Participant qualification and screeningVoxelmaps. Result: fewer rejected participants, more qualified sessions.

Challenge

Unqualified participants kept getting booked, then turned away, wasting sessions.

My role

User Studies Operations Manager, responsible for participant scheduling and onboarding.

What I did

Traced the issue to gaps between recruiters and researchers, corrected the eligibility criteria in screening documents, and trained recruiters.

Result

Fewer rejected participants and more sessions with qualified people.

Why it matters in clinical research: studies rely on clear eligibility criteria and well-trained staff.

Venue recruitment and coordinationTata Elxsi. Result: required venues secured on schedule.

Challenge

Venue details lived in different places, so venues were rejected late and vendors duplicated outreach.

My role

User Studies Operations Project Manager who stepped in as venue recruitment lead during a restructuring.

What I did

Built a shared tracker, clarified venue criteria with the client, and gave vendors clear requirements up front.

Result

No more duplicate outreach, faster responses, and the required venues secured on schedule.

Why it matters in clinical research: qualifying research sites takes the same clear standards and shared tracking.

Digital health projects

Tracing CarePatient Portal & EHR Practice Platform Try the practice portal

A practice patient portal and EHR with made-up patients and records. I design and build it myself. Live at tracing-care.com, no sign-up needed.

How it worksProblem, approach, features, and what’s next

Problem

Students can’t practice EHRs outside a job, and older adults can’t safely practice on real portal accounts.

Approach

Realistic fake data, lessons that mirror real portals, and accessible design with large text and hints.

Features

  • Guided practiceAvailable
    Six everyday portal tasks, step by step.
  • Explore freelyAvailable
    Browse as a made-up patient. No login.
  • Staff trainingPlanned
    For clinical, billing, and admin learners.

Next

An installable web app, then iOS and Android.

My story

  1. Brazil

    Wired for curiosity

    A kid obsessed with Legos and how things fit together. That instinct stuck.

  2. New York, age 14

    Everything changed overnight

    New language, new culture, new everything. It taught me real adaptability.

  3. Tennessee, 2012

    Memphis and logistics

    Living in a global logistics hub sparked my interest in making systems work.

  4. California, 2016

    Operations, evolved

    Tech support at Apple, then operations, and from 2020 research operations, coordinating participants, sites, and teams.

  5. Florida, 2026

    Closer to family

    Moved to be near family, and found my direction in healthcare and clinical research.

  6. Today

    Where it comes together

    Moving into clinical research, and building ways to help people feel confident with health tech through Solara Vita and Tracing Care.
